ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 70%) bordered by low-intensity black pixels (approx. 30%) along the lateral margins and central notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white regions separated by a central black median; right lobe features two distinct, isolated black circular spots; left lobe contains vertical linear streaks and dark stippling near the bottom center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation; interior angle approximately 50-60 degrees with sharp convergence at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude; most prominent peaks occur on the left lobe's upper margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a generally linear trajectory with localized convexities; the bottom-to-tip lateral margins follow a smooth concave arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small high-intensity white clusters (3-5 pixels in diameter) located at the extreme distal tips and along the left-most lateral edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark, unaligned linear streaks visible on the central-left white field, oriented at approximately 45-degree angles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular chipping and jagged edges along the trailing boundary, particularly a deep U-shaped notch-like defect on the outer third of the left lobe.
